finding.expected: Publication mutation must fail if remote main changes from the exact prechecked prior_main_sha before mutation, including when the concurrent new main is still an ancestor of the reviewed candidate. Preserve fast-forward-only publication, no force update, no retry/fallback, and add deterministic regression coverage for the compatible concurrent-main race.
finding.issue: Publication reads and validates prior_main_sha, then performs a plain fast-forward push without binding the mutation to that exact previously observed main SHA. If remote main advances concurrently to another commit that is still an ancestor of REVIEW.reviewed_sha before the push begins, the plain push remains a legal fast-forward and succeeds instead of failing closed. The current regression only injects a divergent concurrent commit, which does not cover this compatible race.
